## How this site is organized

```text
courses/
  mfml/                 ← one folder per lecture series
    lectures/01-.../
    references.qmd
  springboot/           ← Spring Boot practice notes
  SERIES_ID/            ← copy template when you start a new series
references/             ← shared reading list across courses
```

Each series has its **own sidebar**. The top **Courses** menu lists every series. To add another, follow [Add a course](docs/adding-a-course.qmd).
